공통.시작: Create one still photograph. A cinematic film still from a Korean running-brand commercial, 16:9 frame.
공통.배치: Image 1 is a layout guide made from a film frame: the black silhouette marks exactly where the person is in the frame and how big they are, and the grey shapes show where the large light shapes and objects sit. Match the camera position and height, the framing, the person's pose and size, and the placement of the large light shapes exactly. The layout guide has no colours and no textures — use the colours, materials and light described below. Do not copy the outline of the silhouette's hair: follow the hair described below.
공통.한결_얼굴: Use the next four attached photos only as identity references for one Korean man in his early twenties. Keep his face exactly the same in every detail: monolid eyes with no double-eyelid crease, even when narrowed; ears that stick out slightly past his short sides; short black cropped hair with a slightly messy fringe; a slightly angular boyish jaw; a straight nose; light warm skin with faint rosy cheeks and a few faint blemishes on the forehead; clean-shaven. No moles anywhere on his face. Swimmer's build: broad, straight shoulders and a narrow waist. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos.
공통.채원_얼굴: Use the next four attached photos only as identity references for one Korean woman in her mid-twenties. Keep her face exactly the same in every detail: a short black pixie cut; thick straight eyebrows; single eyelids; sun-tanned skin with natural sun freckles across her nose and cheekbones (a light scatter, not dense); a slightly angular, firm jawline. A healthy athletic build with no emphasized muscle definition. Ignore the backgrounds, clothing and lighting of the reference photos.

공통.실험실: Location: a bright sports-science lab — smooth blue-grey walls, cool white overhead light, a black treadmill with curved handrails, a metabolic-testing cart with a small monitor, a clean pale concrete floor. Cool, low-saturation blue-grey colour.
공통.밤트랙: Location: an outdoor running track at night — red rubber track with white lane lines converging towards the horizon, low drifting smoke and mist, and far down the track a tall, glowing, pure white vertical rectangle of light (a free-standing light pillar about two metres tall, like a door made of light) standing on the track; the pillar is the only strong light and backlights everything; the sky is black. The track itself is very dark: only a faint red sheen and thin lane lines near the light, most of the frame is near-black.
공통.검은스튜디오: Location: a pitch-black studio with nothing visible in the background.
